responsibility: Defines regression tests for `SmallCStr`, verifying that it matches `CString` contents and length accounting, uses inline storage for short and empty strings, spills to heap storage for long strings, rejects interior NUL bytes, and supports conversion from `CStr`.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `small_str/tests.rs`, this file is for the C-string variant specifically, so it checks `CString`/`CStr` equivalence, `len_with_nul`, inline-versus-spilled storage, and rejection of interior NUL bytes.
